redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official page, law or metadata used as a validation receipt; access does not imply data redistribution or public-serving rights.
Copyright-restricted, rights-unclear, dated, authority-incomplete or non-data evidence may validate facts but cannot become production output.

sources.production_scope: The August 2026 publication's September 2025 table lists Antigua and Barbuda among countries which do not require postal codes. It supplies policy classification, zero assignment rows and no postal geometry.
The position at 5 February 2026 names the Ministry of Finance and Corporate Governance and Antigua and Barbuda Postal Service. It contains no code assignments or geometry.
The current page binds Antigua and Barbuda to AG and UPU entry on 20 January 1994. It exposes no code or geometry rows.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union / General Post Office
sources.production_scope: The one-page sheet labelled 07/2002 shows General Post Office, St. John's, Antigua and Barbuda without a postcode. It is dated format evidence, not a current exhaustive denominator and not geometry.
The 11 June 2026 signatory list records AG, General Post Office and organization code AGA. Agreement participation does not grant AGID access or reuse and provides no postcode data or geometry.

The page reserves rights, requires written permission for reuse beyond stated exceptions and restricts external duplication of database material. No permission was requested or obtained; raw UPU bodies remain outside Git.

sources.provider: Government of Antigua and Barbuda / Ministry of Legal Affairs
sources.production_scope: The official legal text vests postal administration and post-office establishment rules in Cabinet. It supplies authority context, not a current code list, postal area dataset, data-specific licence or geometry.

artifact_partitions.rule: UPU policy classification remains a nullable-postcode rule and never becomes a fabricated code or area.
Antigua and Barbuda Postal Service, General Post Office, office, route and P.O.-box assertions retain operator and non-area semantics.
Island, parish and locality context remains independently sourced and is not promoted by containment.
Addresses and buildings require separate explicit permitted relations and are never buffered into postal geometry.
Existing AGID draft localities, boundary slots and 246 planning cells remain non-production fixtures and never satisfy promotion evidence.
